$description: SIS motion tokens. W3C design tokens format. Springs, recipes, and rules live under $extensions. The linear keyword round-trips through cubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1).

$extensions.sis.authorization: Adham requested the expanded motion system on 2026-10-28. Exact new values are implementation defaults.

action.use: Button hover and pressed feedback. No input delay.
action.useAr: استجابة التحويم والضغط للأزرار دون تأخير الإدخال.

navigation.use: Sidebar and menu transitions. Focus moves immediately.
navigation.useAr: انتقالات القائمة الجانبية والقوائم مع نقل التركيز فوراً.

disclosure.use: Disclosure content entry. Expanded state changes immediately.
disclosure.useAr: دخول المحتوى الموسع مع إعلان الحالة فوراً.

overlay-enter.use: Dialog and drawer entry, with small logical movement.
overlay-enter.useAr: دخول الحوار واللوحة بحركة منطقية صغيرة.

overlay-exit.use: Overlay dismissal. Do not retain stale focus.
overlay-exit.useAr: إغلاق النافذة دون الاحتفاظ بتركيز قديم.

feedback.use: Toast entry. The status announcement stays immediate.
feedback.useAr: دخول الإشعار مع الإعلان الفوري للحالة.

spring-feedback.use: Optional direct-manipulation settling. Never animate table text or errors.
spring-feedback.useAr: استقرار اختياري للتفاعل المباشر. لا تحرّك نص الجداول أو الأخطاء.

sis.rules: Same registry and sample data produce the same animation keyframes.
Reduced motion removes non-essential movement, including springs.
Focus, pending indicators, error messages, and confirmed results remain immediate.
Cancel and replace interrupted animations. Cancel animations on unmount.
Use motion to explain a change. Do not animate every item continuously.
Avoid repeated bouncing, parallax, flashing, and unrequested looping.
Reserve expressive springs for an explicit, optional interaction example.
Use transforms and opacity where practical. Preserve layout and hit areas.
